name: XtreeE 3D concrete printing system
summary: French robotic 3D concrete printing cell: an ABB 6-axis robot (new or refurbished, on track or pedestal) with XtreeE's xHEAD print head, xFEED pump, mixer and software, sold in four packages from research setups to certified prefab production lines.

germany.statusNote: EU maker (France) sells directly: an online configurator builds the system and sends a quote request, and Germany is in the country list. No public price and no German reseller found.

sellers.name: XtreeE
sellers.note: 5 Rue Noël Pons, 92000 Nanterre, and 25 Rue des Chardons, 72460 Savigné-l'Évêque, France. Packages: Try, Start, Industrial and Research.

specs.label: Manipulator
specs.value: ABB 6-axis robot, new or refurbished, with track, pedestal and arm-extension options
specs.conditions: own robot or gantry can be connected
specs.quote: ABB 6-axis robots recommended by XtreeE for full ecosystem integration. Available new or refurbished, with track, pedestal, and arm extension options.

specs.label: Print head
specs.value: xHEAD 1K or 2K (accelerator dosed at the nozzle); Sprint and Adapt upgrades
specs.quote: The xHEAD 2K also runs in 1K mode

specs.label: Pump
specs.conditions: or the buyer's own concrete pump
specs.quote: The xFEED 3.0 delivers material from the mixer to the print head reliably and consistently.

specs.label: Pre-configured packages
specs.quote: Four pre-configured systems designed for different stages of your 3D printing journey.

specs.label: Certified cell option
specs.value: fully CE-certified production cell (robot, fences, training, project management)
specs.quote: Robot + fences + training + project management. Fully CE-certified production cell.

notes: Robot cell for factory (prefab) production; the robot can sit on a track or pedestal.
Safety levels from basic guards to a full fenced enclosure; a CE-certified cell is offered as a package.
KUKA robots can be connected at a lower integration level; ABB is recommended.
